identity.description: Blocks unsafe modeling practices before they produce misleading results. Checks for duplicate provenance rows as independent observations, target circularity, temporal leakage, invalid splits, and missing baselines. Returns PASS/WARNING/FAIL gates with exact remediation steps.

capabilities.dataCoverage: Full dataset validation: provenance awareness, chronological ordering, feature/target separation

inputs.description: Model target, feature list, source selection, and proposed split/evaluation plan.

outputs.description: PASS/WARNING/FAIL gate with leakage, circularity, split, calibration, and uncertainty findings plus remediation steps.

mustFail: treating repeated provenance rows as independent time observations
skill.userValue: Check source duplication, leakage, target circularity, and time splits before trusting any model. Review the full validation report before relaxing any gate.
